formulas.roe: PAT / average net worth (equity capital + reserves)
formulas.cash_conversion_3y: sum of cash from operations over 3 years / sum of PAT over 3 years
formulas.inventory_days: 365 x average inventory / cost of goods sold
formulas.payable_days: 365 x average trade payables / cost of goods sold
formulas.cycle_days: receivable days + inventory days - payable days

commitments.target: Target a $100 million business in the electronic and specialty chemical segment in 3-4 years.
commitments.quote: And in the period of 3-4 years, as we said, we try to target a $100 million business in this segment, the niche area.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: Guidance has been between 50%-52% odd margin there.
commitments.quote: But our guidance has been between 50%-52% odd margin there.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

claims.claim: Ag chem exports declined by 18% during the period due to price optimization and unpassed cost escalation.
claims.quote: Ag Chem exports declined by 18% during the period. We remained focused on driving volume growth post-genericization through price optimization while cost escalation could not be passed through in this current market conditions.

claims.claim: Domestic agri business grew 19% year-on-year supported by differentiated products and biologicals.
claims.quote: Our domestic business continues to hold its ground with strong year-on-year growth of 19% despite the challenging market dynamics, supported by a portfolio of differentiated high-value crop protection solutions and strong market position across key brands.

claims.claim: Domestic biologicals portfolio grew by 45% and global portfolio saw over 250% growth this quarter.
claims.quote: Our domestic portfolio has grown by 45% and our global portfolio has seen more than 250% growth this quarter as farmers continue to adopt sustainable solutions.

claims.claim: Pharma business grew 20% year-on-year supported by deepening customer engagement.
claims.quote: Our pharma business grew 20% year-on-year supported by deepening engagement with customers showing early shoots and building development & manufacturing capabilities.

claims.claim: Reduced net working capital by 18 days and released Rs. 298 crores of cash.
claims.quote: Keeping business hygiene a priority, we reduce net working capital by 18 days, releasing Rs. 298 crores of cash as at quarter end.

claims.claim: New molecules account for 16% to 18% of the Ag Chem exports business.
claims.quote: All the new molecules which we have been commercializing, account for 16% to 18% of our Ag Chem exports business and it can vary on quarter to quarter basis, but on a yearly basis, it is around 16% to 18%.

analyst_concerns.question: Could you break down the export revenue between pharma, biologics, and agrochemical CSM?
analyst_concerns.quote: Would be possible to just help us with the breakdown between these three buckets because we are not exactly able to back into the biologics number.

analyst_concerns.question: What is the normalized level of margins expected on gross and EBITDA margin sides?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, what is the normalized level of margins that we expect you know and yes, both on the gross margin side and the EBITDA margin side if you could just share your perspective there.

analyst_concerns.question: Could you share the order book number?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, my first question is if you could share the order book number?

analyst_concerns.question: Are patented molecules also facing pricing pressure?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, is it fair to believe now that even the patented molecules are also kind of facing pricing pressure, which was not the case earlier, which was only restricted to generic products?

commitments.quote: We have given a guidance of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore, which is the standard capex as you rightly said.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: ETR for FY27 to be around 24%
commitments.quote: We expect ETR for FY27 to be around 24%.
commitments.speaker: Sanjay Agarwal

claims.claim: Delivered a 12% volume growth in the domestic market, translating into a 3% revenue growth.
claims.quote: Despite a challenging operating environment in the domestic market, we delivered a 12% volume growth in this quarter, translating into a 3% revenue growth.

claims.claim: Delivered an impressive reduction of 19 days in net working capital, releasing INR 300 crore of cash.
claims.quote: Despite the challenging environment, the team delivered an impressive reduction of 19 days in net working capital, releasing INR 300 crore of cash.

claims.claim: Maintained a healthy gross margin of 57% and EBITDA at 22% during the quarter.
claims.quote: For Q1 FY27, reported revenue is Rs. 17,023 million with a healthy gross margin of 57% and EBITDA at 22%.

analyst_concerns.question: Why did rupee depreciation not cover the volume decline in exports?
analyst_concerns.quote: What is the disconnect that I am finding here?

analyst_concerns.question: Where is money being spent in subsidiaries and when will they break even?
analyst_concerns.quote: So what is the disconnect or where we are spending our money in the subsidiaries? If you could explain that?

analyst_concerns.question: How should escalating R&D and subsidiary EBITDA losses be looked at over the medium term?
analyst_concerns.quote: So how should we look at these losses going ahead?

analyst_concerns.question: What does commercialization mean for electronic chemicals given lack of substantial revenue?
analyst_concerns.quote: What exactly do you mean, when you say commercialized because we have not seen anything significant or substantial come out of that bucket.

unverified.target: positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier
unverified.quote: You see, as we stated earlier, we are looking at a positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier.

commitments.target: Achieve a top line of INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore in pharma segment in a couple of years
commitments.quote: As we have stated earlier, achieving a INR 500 crore – INR 600 crore top line is when you would see these things move into a positive phase. This could be a couple of years, if not a bit more than that to get to that phase.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: Maintain resilient EBITDA margin of 25% for full year
commitments.quote: Further, at EBITDA level, we delivered what we committed at the start of the year a resilient margin of 25% for full year.
commitments.speaker: Sanjay Agarwal

claims.claim: Our Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year.
claims.quote: Our Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year.

claims.claim: Biologicals has been compounding at over 20%+, emerging as one of the fastest-growing segments.
claims.quote: Over the past few years this business has emerged as one of the fastest-growing segments within our portfolio compounding at over 20%+.

claims.claim: Gross margin expanded to 58% during the quarter and year supported by mix and operational efficiencies.
claims.quote: Our gross margin expanded to 58% during the quarter & for the year, supported by a favourable product mix and strong operational efficiencies.

claims.claim: New products now contribute 18% of AgChem Exports, highlighting derisking and innovation approach.
claims.quote: New products now contributing 18% of AgChem Exports highlights our focused derisking strategy and innovation led approach.

claims.claim: On a full year basis, the ETR for FY26 remains at 22%.
claims.quote: on a full year basis, the ETR for FY26 remains at 22%.

analyst_concerns.question: Where is capex directed and when will INR 2,600 crore convert to revenue given drop in asset turns?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, wanted to understand where this capex is being directed to and, some sense in terms of how much of it is being focused towards the legacy projects and the new projects. And when do you expect this capex to be translating into the revenues?

analyst_concerns.question: EBITDA margin compressed from 27%-28% to 22% in recent quarters; how to think about margins for fiscal 27?
analyst_concerns.quote: whereas we started the year with a 27%-28% margin profile. Just going into fiscal ‘27, if you could just give us some sense of, you know, how should we think about margin profiles both on the gross margin level and the EBITDA margin level?

analyst_concerns.question: Why has agrochemicals remained dominant despite a decade of discussing adjacencies like pharma and electronic chemicals?
analyst_concerns.quote: as on today, from management’s perspective, was the original assumption that PI’s process chemistry and customer trust advantages would automatically transfer more easily across domains than they actually did? And what has been the biggest, unexpected challenge in building meaningful non-agro scale?

analyst_concerns.question: What would CSM export growth be excluding the largest product, pyroxasulfone, for FY26?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, just apart from the new molecules, even the existing molecules which you would have launched prior to that, right? So, if we just strip out the impact of the largest product, pyroxasulfone, excluding that, would there have been growth in FY26 in CSM exports or that would have been a YoY decline?

unverified.target: Target about $80 million to $100 million of revenue in electronic chemicals space in 5-6 years
unverified.quote: Five-six years is the estimate about somewhere about $ 80 million to $ 100 million of revenue in this space.

commitments.target: 500 crore to 600 crore capex broadly for FY27
commitments.quote: So broadly, it will be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore.

commitments.target: commercialize 8 to 10 new molecules with 5 already commercialized

claims.claim: Reported revenue of INR 13,757 million for Q3 FY26
claims.quote: For quarter 3 FY26, we reported revenue of INR 13,757 million, which comes on the back of a high base of the previous years.

claims.claim: Pharma platform delivered a 50% year-on-year growth
claims.quote: Now coming to Pharma, we have delivered a 50% year-on-year growth.

claims.claim: Gross margin expanded to 59% during the quarter supported by product mix and cost discipline
claims.quote: On other financial metrices, our gross margin expanded to 59% during the quarter, supported by a favorable product mix and cost discipline.

claims.claim: Trade working capital in terms of days of sales increased to 139 days
claims.quote: Our trade working capital in terms of days of sales has increased to 139 days and reflects current market conditions, we expect to improve this as market scenario normalizes in the coming quarters.

claims.claim: Domestic agrochemical demand remained subdued due to high channel inventory and low commodity prices
claims.quote: Domestic agrochemical demand remains subdued due to high channel inventory, low commodity prices, delay in normalization of biological portfolio post regulatory headwind and specific impact from lower demand in a few target crops for PI.

claims.claim: Net profit includes write-back of contingent consideration of INR 1,260 million offset by retirement benefits provisioning
claims.quote: During the quarter, net profit includes an exceptional income in our pharma business on account for a write-back of contingent consideration of INR 1,260 million which has been partly offset by additional provisioning of retirement benefits as per New Labour Code to the tune of INR 209 million.

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst pressed for details on whether expected Q4 and FY27 growth is volume or value, and the magnitude.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, first question is on the guidance. When you say growth resuming in fourth quarter, is it only a sequential growth that you are talking about or you even expect a Y-o-Y growth and what this growth is really? Is it like a volume growth that you are alluding to? Or do you even expect a revenue growth or a value growth in the fourth quarter?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst asked about the gap between high delivered gross margins and the long-term guidance of 50-52%.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, we have been delivering quite good kind of gross margins for last few quarters. What is the gap between what is your expectations on a sustainable basis? And what we are delivering? What is this gap attributed to?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst inquired about heavy quarterly EBITDA losses in pharma and biologics and peak investment timeline.
analyst_concerns.quote: Now if you look at the numbers, we are heavily investing in these businesses, and we are roughly at a INR 75 crore, INR 80 crore quarterly EBITDA loss in these segments So, how should we think about the investments from our medium to longer term? And are we at the peak of the investment in these businesses? And going ahead, the investment should move in line with our overall OPEX?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst pressed on the sharp increase in working capital days from 68 to 139 days.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, my second question, Sanjay, if you can throw some light, there has been an increase in the working capital quite sharply, almost from 68 days to 139 days Y-o-Y. So, could you please explain and how we should expect the intensity of working capital coming down?

annual.what_it_does: PI Industries Ltd is a science-led, innovation-driven life sciences company operating in agrisciences, custom synthesis and manufacturing, biologicals, and specialty chemicals. It provides integrated crop solutions, active ingredients, formulations, and pharmaceutical CRDMO services globally.

segments.name: Agro Chemicals
segments.note: Active ingredients, formulations and Custom Synthesis and Manufacturing.

segments.name: Pharma
segments.note: Pharma CRDMO, discovery and development services.

annual.customers: Serves over 1.6 million farmers via 15,000+ distributors in India and long-term global innovator partners.

facts.fact: PI employs over 700 scientists and 200+ PhDs across R&D facilities.
Domestic agribusiness serves over 1.6 million farmers across 45,000 villages.
Consolidated revenue of 67,137 million in FY26.
Total permanent employees and workers stand at 3,840 on a consolidated basis.

annual.geography: Operates globally with revenue from India, Asia, North America, Europe, and Rest of the World.
annual.revenue_mix_basis: Share of revenue from operations for the year ended March 31, 2026 based on segment reporting.

risks.risk: Geopolitical and macroeconomic risks affecting trade flows, supply chains, and inflation.
R&D, technology and competitive risks including potential delays or failures in product development.
Foreign exchange and working capital risks from global transactions and seasonal demand.
Environmental, social and governance risks regarding compliance and stakeholder expectations.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted pharma growth of 40% in FY26 and 20% in Q2 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN overall revenue dropped 12.5% in FY26 to Rs 6,714 crore and fell 9.1% YoY in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted resilient operational profitability and expanding gross margins.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN opm dropped from 27.7% in FY25 to 25.8% in FY26, collapsing to 13.7% in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management cited working capital reduction of 18-19 days releasing around Rs 300 crore cash.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN annual cycle days expanded from 45.1 days in FY25 to 83.1 days in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported AgChem exports dropped 18% due to price optimization.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN Q2 FY27 revenue fell 9.1% YoY to Rs 1,702 crore and PAT fell 70.2% to Rs 122 crore.

bull.point: 3-year cash conversion is solid at 84.1% with net debt to EBITDA at -1.062, keeping balance sheet net cash positive.
Domestic agribusiness grew 19% YoY in Q2 FY27 driven by biologicals growing 45% domestically and 250% globally.
Pharma business demonstrated high growth, expanding 40% in FY26 and 20% YoY in Q2 FY27.

bear.point: Revenue declined 12.5% in FY26 to Rs 6,714 crore, while Q2 FY27 PAT fell 70.2% YoY to Rs 122 crore.
Free cash flow turned negative at -Rs 632 crore in FY26 as operating cash flow fell to Rs 474 crore.
Operating profit margin compressed severely to 13.7% in Sep 2026 quarter from 28.9% in Sep 2025.

watch.point: Recovery in operating margin from the trough of 13.7% recorded in Sep 2026 quarter.
Execution of capex against the revised guidance of Rs 700 to Rs 800 crore for FY27.
Status of new molecule commercializations towards achieving the target of 8 to 10 molecules.
